trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Everything is single-player: there are no online or DLC trophies, no difficulty settings and no mission replay, so one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the platinum about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, most of it on the 100% checklist, so follow this guide's roadmap: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1. It pops as soon as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 1. It pops when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the final mission of the story. Free roam carries on after the credits, so you can clean up everything else afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: you need 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. In full it needs every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. This is the hardest trophy and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories and pick what is quickest for you; flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. Track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one hoop), playing a video game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt. Check what is left under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most of these happen naturally while working on the story and the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges are not too hard, and they also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. PowerPyx and GTABase both publish a full guide to all 12 range locations and their 42 gold medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough for this trophy. There are 42 drone races in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so finish every race at a location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep moving to races you have not won yet.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon. Work through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge to take the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You must reach the end of the game; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts Lucia an address in Belville. Complete her five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams. He calls, then is marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: find the purple chest markers, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. He disappears after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again later, so the line is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. The last one awards the trophy, and the quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only certain strangers count: confirmed so far are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. The questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All stranger strands stay available after the story, and you can watch your count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); the first, a Granforma Zorrusso, is delivered during that story mission. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is wanted, and hunt around hotel driveways at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Cars delivered in good condition pay more, and the line can still be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone marks synthetic labs in purple around Vice City. Destroy enough labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, and he then gives his second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which awards the trophy. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Do the missable one in Chapter 1: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony; follow her and choose Accept. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it. The last meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Bret texts Jason; the first quest is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69. Hunt the animals he requests on his Target Decks (purple map icons) and bring them back to him as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which exact animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed, but the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through them all.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; there are 18 sets in total, and you do not need all of them. Track how close each set is in the Progress menu under Collections.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1). Any 100 count, drawn from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 spots in the world, so scan whatever you pass. The 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK scans too.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (8 groups of 10). Track them under Progress, then Challenges; finished ones are ticked. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one pops along the way. Save it for late, then pick the easiest challenges you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. This is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can free-roam together; call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports bike. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape: cops and helicopters struggle to follow you there. It also pops naturally during bank vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you stay wanted (keep the flashing red and blue wanted level, not the red heat level). Bring body armor, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, sit close together: loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up on the D-pad) and scan vehicles with R1; you only need to scan them, not drive them. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this comes automatically. Check your counts under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and highlights weak spots). Fill your Focus first: eat, drink, or wash up at home, and use Adrenaline to make it last longer. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 and pick gang operation thugs as targets; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets much easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA; planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is at gates E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs and the door by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport. The trophy pops once you are far enough away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun and unlock jewelry store robberies. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun; kicking the door in triggers the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave without being detected. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (after his earlier quests). Each vault pays up to $205,000 and always gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and then switch vehicles. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal: robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier, you can also box in an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane; fly over every black fogged patch until the entire map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and there are 39 in total. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. The trophy pops a moment after you drive away down the street. Only the blue Banshee counts: it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation to blow it). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit: the robbery respawns after a long time, so you can come back for what you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia. Buy a fitness club membership and always train with your partner along (hold Right on the D-pad and press Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities. After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count, and most players earn this passively while working on the other trophies. Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 20 Nov 2026. PowerPyx believes this trophy relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way; the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. GTABase lists the exact steps as not yet confirmed. Do not grind blindly for this one: check the sources linked beside this guide for the community's latest findings.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it: it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random; if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach, where there are plenty of people to pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 to get the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, and the robberies for the 100% checklist get you there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive and the fastest way to use it up. Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, about $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses). The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes), and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
